journal.restless.bestiary.poltergeist: Loud and restless: doors, chests and things move on their own. Hardly dangerous at first.
journal.restless.bestiary.shade: Quiet: puts out lights, whispers and slowly wears you down. Gets crueler over time.
journal.restless.bestiary.shade.name: Shade
journal.restless.bestiary.phantom: Wants to pass for a living person: a stranger far off, a name that isn't there. Rarely hurts anyone.
journal.restless.bestiary.phantom.name: Phantom
journal.restless.bestiary.nix: Stays near water. Holds swimmers under, calls you toward the shore, breaks boats.
journal.restless.bestiary.nix.name: Nix

journal.restless.bestiary.mimic.name: Mimic
journal.restless.bestiary.wraith: Hunts in the dark. Puts your light out first, then comes closer.
journal.restless.bestiary.wraith.name: Wraith
journal.restless.bestiary.mara: Sits on sleepers. Worse at night, and worst of all while you're in bed.
journal.restless.bestiary.mara.name: Mara
journal.restless.bestiary.banshee: Mostly a voice: makes a lot of noise but barely touches anything.
journal.restless.bestiary.banshee.name: Banshee
journal.restless.bestiary.revenant: Out for revenge: hurts you, sends animals after you and remembers every kill.
journal.restless.bestiary.revenant.name: Revenant
journal.restless.bestiary.lost_one: Wanders: shapes, footsteps, strangers far off. Follows you even underground.
journal.restless.bestiary.lost_one.name: Lost one
journal.restless.bestiary.domovoi: Lives in a house: doors, belongings, noises in the corners. Mostly harmless.
journal.restless.bestiary.domovoi.name: Domovoi
journal.restless.bestiary.hoarder: Stays in one place and takes whatever you leave lying there.
journal.restless.bestiary.hoarder.name: Hoarder
journal.restless.bestiary.demon: Stays in one place and is dangerous: hits you, makes you sick and sends animals after you.
journal.restless.bestiary.demon.name: Demon
journal.restless.bestiary.trickster: Stays in one place and plays tricks: changes blocks and items, shows you things that aren't there.
journal.restless.bestiary.trickster.name: Trickster
journal.restless.bestiary.boggart: Fakes what disgusts: swarms of tiny spiders and vermin that only you see, running at you.
journal.restless.bestiary.boggart.name: Boggart
journal.restless.guide.start.title: Read this first
journal.restless.guide.start.1: The dead here don't rest. Some latch onto a living person and follow them everywhere. Others stay where they died.
journal.restless.guide.start.2: They start out weak, but the longer they're left alone, the stronger they get. I learned that the hard way. Some things I never worked out, so some pages are blank.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.title: Signs
journal.restless.guide.haunted.1: Doors slam on their own, torches go out, steps sound where nobody is walking. That's a spirit, and it won't stop by itself.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.2: A spirit candle leans toward whoever the spirit will go for next, and burns blue just before it comes. A spirit compass points at the nearest spirit. They can't cross a closed ring of salt. I tested it.
journal.restless.guide.haunted.3: Only tools tell you which spirit it is. Ash shows its prints, a camera obscura takes its picture, and a spirit box and an ouija board talk to it. Each tool shows only part of the truth.
journal.restless.guide.clues.title: Telling them apart
journal.restless.guide.clues.1: Every spirit has several habits, and one clue shows only one of them. So I never decided anything from a single note and waited until I had a few.
journal.restless.guide.clues.2: Photos and ash prints never lie. The spirit box and the board sometimes do, so I marked every note from them "could be lying". In fact only a liar lies, and only about half the time. If the board and the box keep saying the same thing, it can be trusted.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.title: The altar
journal.restless.guide.weakness.1: A spirit can be banished at the altar, but first you have to know its nature. There are four, each with its own weakness: iron, glowstone, holy water and mirror. Nearly all of a spirit's habits come from its nature, and only one doesn't fit.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.2: You can tell the nature by what the spirit does. It touches things, slams doors, goes through chests, moves the world around you: that's iron. It reaches for darkness, cold and night: that's glowstone. It takes revenge, holds grudges, comes with the rain or calls from the deep: that's holy water. It whispers, makes noise, steals sleep or lies, playing with your head: that's mirror.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.3: Ash doesn't lie. A paw means iron, a drag mark means glowstone, a hoof means holy water, a bare foot means mirror. One of the spirit's habits is foreign and leaves a foreign print, so trust the print you see most. Until ash confirmed my guess, I didn't go to the altar: a mistake costs too much.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.4: Knowing the nature isn't enough: each kind of spirit takes it in its own form. Some want the thing whole, some a bit of it, some something crafted from it. The bestiary says which, on the kind's page that appears after the first photo. Then I built an altar, put four lit candles around it, closed a ring of salt and laid the offering in the bowl. If the form is wrong, the spirit still takes the offering, but the ritual drags on.
journal.restless.guide.weakness.5: During the ritual the spirit fights back: it puts out candles and hits. Relight a candle as soon as it goes out. Getting the nature wrong is worse: every candle goes out, the spirit flies into a rage, hides for a day and keeps you from the altar, and it gets a step closer to growing into something worse.
journal.restless.guide.graves.title: Graves
journal.restless.guide.graves.1: Every spirit used to be someone. The grave turned up a few hundred blocks from home, and the stone says who they were and what they lost.
journal.restless.guide.graves.2: When I brought the lost thing to the grave, the spirit came to rest. It worked better than any ritual, and there was no nature to guess. When my head started going, the spirit box told me where the bones were.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.title: Your head
journal.restless.guide.sanity.1: Darkness, cursed ground and every scare wore me down. Light, food, sleep and salt brought me back.
journal.restless.guide.sanity.2: The worse shape I was in, the more the spirit box picked up.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.title: Left alone
journal.restless.guide.evolution.1: A spirit left alone long enough turns into something worse, and it doesn't turn back. The ground around some of them goes grey.
journal.restless.guide.evolution.2: Once the spirit is banished or at rest, the ground comes back to life.
journal.restless.guide.essence.title: Essence
journal.restless.guide.essence.1: Some spirits leave essence behind. A ritual gave me one. A grave put right gave more.
journal.restless.guide.essence.2: Every kind of spirit leaves its own essence, and charms are made from it. Poltergeist essence pulls dropped items in, shade essence lets you see in the dark. The other charms are crafted from an essence and one common thing, and the charm's name tells you whose it is.
restless.relighting.title: Relighting
restless.relighting.description: Right-click the placed light with flint and steel or a lit torch. Flint and steel loses 1 durability; torches are not consumed. Cannot ignite underwater.

journal.restless.met.poltergeist: Where it's met: in woodland mansions and trail ruins. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.shade: Where it's met: it may latch on from the very start, for no reason at all. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.nix: Where it's met: at shipwrecks and ocean ruins. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight by the water.
journal.restless.met.phantom: Where it's met: it may latch on from the very start, for no reason at all. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.mimic: Where it's met: it may latch on from the very start, for no reason at all. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.wraith: Where it's met: it may latch on from the very start, for no reason at all. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.mara: Where it's met: it may latch on from the very start, for no reason at all. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.banshee: Where it's met: it comes when a villager or a pet dies before my eyes, or when a pet is lost. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.revenant: Where it's met: it comes after a slaughter of animals and villagers, or after I kill my own pet. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.lost_one: Where it's met: it comes after I die far from home, or after two days without sleep. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.domovoi: Where it's met: in villages, rarely. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.hoarder: Where it's met: in igloos and pyramids. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.demon: Where it's met: at ruined portals, ancient cities, bastions and fortresses. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.
journal.restless.met.trickster: Where it's met: at swamp huts. You can call one on purpose with an effigy: a scarecrow stuffed with its essence and set alight.

message.restless.bell_silent: The bell has nothing to give back.

message.restless.requiem_missed: %s was not answered. A candle goes out.
message.restless.requiem_aborted: The Requiem is broken off. Nothing is lost.
message.restless.requiem_failed: The Requiem fails. The essence (%s) is lost, the dead are angrier, and the altar will not answer for three days.
message.restless.requiem_bargain: A voice offers a bargain: be spared this movement for the price of %3$s candles. %1$s or %2$s?

message.restless.requiem_refused: You refuse. The voice goes quiet.

requiem.restless.cue.shade: The light dies around the altar. Keep at least 4 lights burning.
requiem.restless.cue.poltergeist: Your things fly from your pockets. Pick them all up again.
requiem.restless.cue.nix: Water rises in the circle. Do not drown, and keep the altar dry.
requiem.restless.cue.phantom: Strangers stand outside the ring. Do not look at them.
requiem.restless.cue.mimic: Two more altars have risen. Lay holy water on the true one.
requiem.restless.cue.wraith: Darkness, and blows from nowhere. Stay above three hearts, and keep to the light.
requiem.restless.cue.mara: A heavy sleep falls. Only a steady mind wakes.
requiem.restless.cue.banshee: A wail. Ring the bell when the silence comes.
requiem.restless.cue.revenant: The things you killed rise. Kill them all.
requiem.restless.cue.lost_one: You are lost. Find your way back into the ring in time.
requiem.restless.cue.domovoi: Doors slam open. Close every door near the altar.
requiem.restless.cue.hoarder: Your offering is stolen. It lies in one of the chests.
requiem.restless.cue.trickster: Candles go out and change places. Relight what was lit, and leave the false ones.
requiem.restless.cue.boggart: Spiders swarm at you. They are not real. Hold your ground by the altar.
journal.restless.guide.requiem.title: Requiem
journal.restless.guide.requiem.1: I carried one essence of every kind to the altar and sang them out. Their business was finished, and so, in the only way that counted, was mine.
journal.restless.guide.requiem.2: Nothing is born on me now, and nothing acts on me. The reliquary became a bell. If I miss them, I can crouch and ring it, and three of them will come back.
advancements.restless.requiem.title: Requiem
advancements.restless.requiem.descriptio: Sing every spirit out, and be let go
requiem.restless.title: Requiem
requiem.restless.poem.1: They came to you in the dark, each asking for one small thing:
requiem.restless.poem.2: a light, a name, a door, a hand to hold.
requiem.restless.poem.3: You learned their faces by what they took from you,
requiem.restless.poem.4: and their names by what they left behind.
requiem.restless.poem.6: Salt on the sill. A candle that would not stay lit.
requiem.restless.poem.7: Fourteen kinds of grief in one quiet box,
requiem.restless.poem.9: You sang it aloud, and it was not a spell.
requiem.restless.poem.11: Now the stones stand and the names are read.
requiem.restless.poem.12: The cold goes out of the rooms; the rooms are only rooms.
requiem.restless.poem.13: Nobody walks behind you. Nobody waits in the dark.
requiem.restless.poem.15: Go home. The night is only night.
item.restless.salt.tip: Place it as a ring: no spirit's event runs on whoever stands inside.
item.restless.ash.tip: Place it: spirits leave prints that show one trait. Never lies.
item.restless.spirit_candle.tip: Hold it: the flame leans to the spirit that acts next.
item.restless.spirit_compass.tip: Hold it: the needle points at the nearest spirit.
item.restless.camera_obscura.tip: Use it: a photo shows the type of a spirit nearby.
item.restless.photo.tip: Shows the type of a spirit. Never lies.
item.restless.spirit_box.tip: Place it and speak: it answers with a word. May lie.
item.restless.ouija_board.tip: Place it and use it: it spells out a trait. May lie.
item.restless.door_charm.tip: Stick to a block: stops door events within 8 blocks. Breaks after 5.
item.restless.dreamcatcher.tip: Hang it: no event runs on you asleep within 5 blocks.
item.restless.hallowed_lantern.tip: No spirit's event runs on you within 6 blocks.
item.restless.scarecrow.tip: Stops any event within 16 blocks. Breaks after 10.
item.restless.effigy.tip: Stuff with an essence and light it to call that spirit.
item.restless.altar.tip: Banish spirits here: offer inside a salt ring among lit candles.
item.restless.holy_water.tip: Altar offering of the holy water nature.
item.restless.mirror.tip: Altar offering of the mirror nature.
item.restless.essence.tip: A banished spirit's remains. Craft it into charms, consumables and relics.
item.restless.telekinesis_amulet.tip: Use: pulls dropped items and experience to you.
item.restless.dark_eye.tip: Use: see in the dark; living things and spirits show.
item.restless.drowned_stone.tip: Worn: breathe and swim freely in water; slow on land.
item.restless.borrowed_face.tip: Use: hostile mobs take you for their own for 25 seconds.
item.restless.phantom_double.tip: Use: a copy of you draws hostile mobs for 8 seconds.
item.restless.wraith_shroud.tip: Use: blows pass through you for 5 seconds.
item.restless.borrowed_dream.tip: Use: sanity back to full. Angers your spirits. Once a day.
item.restless.death_wail.tip: Worn: below 3 hearts it throws hostile mobs back. Once a day.
item.restless.grudge.tip: Worn: stores damage you take; your next blow adds half.
item.restless.lost_step.tip: Use: slip up to 8 blocks ahead, through thin walls.
item.restless.house_key.tip: Worn, in a shut roofed room: spirits' events do not run.
item.restless.stash.tip: Right-click: opens a slot for one stack. In your inventory it survives your death.
item.restless.bargain.tip: Use: full health and strong effects, then two hearts fewer.
item.restless.trickster_coin.tip: Use: wager your next kill; its drops double or are lost.
item.restless.fetch_path.tip: Use: the Lost Step, leaving a copy of you behind.
item.restless.changeling_mask.tip: Use: the Borrowed Face; your first blow frames the mob you hit.
item.restless.nightwalk_shroud.tip: Worn: in dim light hostile mobs lose you; you pass through mobs. Held without Curios: use to toggle.
item.restless.blood_debt.tip: Worn: the Grudge, uncapped; a killing blow heals you.
item.restless.requital_wail.tip: Worn: the Death Wail; mobs it throws back take more damage.
item.restless.tidecaller.tip: Worn: the Drowned Stone, with a dash in water and rain.
item.restless.magpies_hook.tip: Worn: the Rod, near items only. Sneak-use on a container to link it.
item.restless.truthseers_eye.tip: Worn: the Dark Lens's sight; the next reading cannot lie. Once a day.
item.restless.hearth_dream.tip: Use in a shut roofed room: sanity to full, no anger. Once a day.
item.restless.keepers_key.tip: Worn: the House Key, bound to one room, where it never wears.
item.restless.grave_satchel.tip: Worn: the Stash for three stacks. Rests three days after your death.
item.restless.devils_coin.tip: Use: the Trickster's Coin; wagers every kill for 30 seconds.
item.restless.twins_mirror.tip: Use: the Phantom Double, standing where you look.
item.restless.black_bargain.tip: Use: the Bargain with longer fury; costs sanity, not hearts.
item.restless.still_water.tip: Drink: clears the weather. Sneaking: a storm. Then the weather runs its own course.
item.restless.dreamless_draught.tip: Drink before bed: sleep near monsters and wake calmer.
item.restless.wayfinders_ash.tip: Use: footprints lead to where you died for 5 minutes. Sneaking: to your spawn.
item.restless.magpie_feather.tip: Use: a stream of light leads to the nearest unopened loot chest or barrel for 5 minutes.
item.restless.changeling_dust.tip: Use on a block to swap the whole joined body of it for kin, or on a novice villager to redo trades.
item.restless.bloodied_rag.tip: Throw: mobs of that type nearby go for it until it dies.
item.restless.wraith_oil.tip: Use with a weapon in the other hand: 30 harder blows in the dark.
item.restless.infernal_contract.tip: Use with an enchanted item in the other hand: one enchantment goes a level higher.
item.restless.restless_knot.tip: Tie to a container: it takes in dropped items nearby. Sneak with a knot on it to take it back.
item.restless.dusk_salt.tip: Scatter: no hostile mob spawns nearby. Sneak with salt near the spot to sweep it up.
item.restless.sighting_mark.tip: Place: a waypoint shows through walls on every screen. Use it on the mark to take it back.
item.restless.mimic_clay.tip: Press on a block to take its look, then set it down. It turns as you set it.
item.restless.omen_candle.tip: Light it: the next harmful event nearby is announced 5 seconds ahead, then it goes out.
item.restless.domovois_porridge.tip: Eat: crops and young animals around you grow faster until you die or drink milk.
item.restless.hoarders_hollow.tip: A chest shared by all your hollows. Disguise it with mimic clay.
item.restless.reliquary.tip: Holds one essence of every type, for the Requiem.
item.restless.requiem_bell.tip: Sneak and ring it for 5 seconds to take back your release.
item.restless.ferrymans_coin.tip: Worn: a killing blow fades you instead. Rests 3 days.
item.restless.exorcists_censer.tip: Off hand at the altar: shorter ritual, candles stay lit, one more essence.
item.restless.hollow_lantern.tip: Wards 24 blocks and writes a clue for every event it stops.
item.restless.maras_cradle.tip: A bed: all sanity back, and the night does not pass.
item.restless.gravestone.tip: Use to read. Give it what the spirit wants to lay it to rest.
item.restless.journal.tip: Records everything you learn about spirits.
